authors_reviews.title: Bearded Guys/ Beard Growers Read this before you buy.....
authors_reviews.text: I'm using this product for past 5 years and completely satisfied with the performance. I have a pretty oily face, and it clears the oil without overdrying. However, this clears the oil when you wash but ut it doesn't protect you skin from oil build up post washing.The whitening effect (a healthy whitening glow) is really awesome. Cleaning and Whitening effect is completely miraculous as oily face tends to look real dull.Now coming to the Main concern.....I've been sporting a full beard from past 7 years and never ever shaved till date.The Problem with this facewash is it's Whitening Effect. I've noticed that this facewash is lightening the natural color of my beard. It is not possible to wash the face without getting the foam in contact with beard follicles.The whitening effect is enough to lighten your natural color of beard in just 2 weeks of usage (2 times a day)I NEVER wash my beard with any face wash but with Himalaya Baby Shampoo.But I love this facewash so I found a way and it is personally tested.*Limit the use of face wash. Wash with it only in morning.*Applying a light coat of Oil on your beard before using this facewash.*Wash your beard with A Beard wash or with a Baby Shampoo after using this Facewash. (You don't have to wash your beard daily but follow the routine of washing it in 2 days atleast)*Using any oil on beard post facewash.
